project.name: VexelRay GUI :: Plot
project.description: Reliable graphing: evaluate an expression over a whole column of x at once and get back an enclosure that provably contains every value it takes there. That is what lets a plotted curve be honest about poles and domain gaps instead of aliasing over them. On top of that substrate: a frame, the classification of a column into what it draws as, and the policy that chooses a window. Rendering is not here — it needs a node vocabulary, and this module deliberately has no dependencies. See docs/reliable-plotting.md.
